title: Program -> Agent -> Phase Binding Compiler

acceptance_gates.gate_1_every_agent_owned_node_resolves_e: VERIFIED (All agent-owned nodes resolve 1-to-1 to registered AgentDefinitions across Research Canonicalization and Script Program)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_lane_skill_tool_contract_compatib: VERIFIED (Authority Lane parity, skill availability, tool capabilities, and typed output contracts are verified per node)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_missing_agent_or_ambiguous_mappin: VERIFIED (Missing agents raise UnresolvedAgentAssignmentError; un-disambiguated multi-agent matches raise AmbiguousAgentAssignmentError)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_runtime_node_stores_binding_ident: VERIFIED (CompiledAgentNodeAssignment captures agent_content_sha256 and deterministic binding_sha256)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_evidence_links_to_program_manifes: VERIFIED (ProgramAgentPhaseBindingManifest captures program_id, program_version, program_manifest_sha256, and state_machine_id)

false_proof_defenses.defense_1_agent_removed_from_manifest: BLOCKED (Removing an agent from program manifest raises UnresolvedAgentAssignmentError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_2_authority_lane_mismatch: BLOCKED (Assigning a COMPOSER Agent to a HUNTER node raises LaneBindingMismatchError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_3_incompatible_skill_binding: BLOCKED (Declaring a skill not granted to the agent raises IncompatibleSkillBindingError)
false_proof_defenses.defense_4_unresolved_output_contract: BLOCKED (Agent-owned node without declared or agent-derived output contract raises UnresolvedOutputContractError)

limitations: Typed Agent Result Explicit Gate Engine will be formalized in Mandate M54
Bounded Repair Same-Session Retry loops will be implemented in Mandate M55
